title: Theory of Mind in Preschool Children, School Children, Youths and Adults Born Preterm or Full-term
brief_summary: This study tests preschoolers, school children, youths and young adults, who were born preterm or full-term, in their theory of mind abilities.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* informed consent
* preterm: birthweight \<1500g
* full-term: born after 38 weeks

Exclusion Criteria:

* no informed consent
study_population: preterms were born in the University Hospital of Cologne
